verdict.rationale: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform that could plausibly offer versioned automations or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents APIs, webhooks, sandboxes and themes, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Sandboxes and trial stores are adjacent testing environments, not version control or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
